reason: Three locked acceptance tests outside the D-4 re-pin fail under the spec as written. SPEC-12 requires them unchanged; each needs either a further locked re-pin or a spec change.
evidence: 1) tests/advice/value-bet.acceptance.test.ts:299-312 'AC#9 recommendation keeps existing fields and adds calling-range equity' asserts Object.keys(recommendPostflop(view)) equals exactly TASK_7_3_KEYS + equityVsCallingRangePct, impliedRequiredEquityPct, outs, explanation. D-2/D-4 add opponentBasis to every PostflopRecommendation (D-4's own re-pin includes it in unseen mode), so the key list can never match. 2) tests/advice/preflop.acceptance.test.ts:295-318 'AC#6 passing HandState to the advice API fails typecheck' copies a fixed list of src files into a sandbox and runs tsc; the list has src/advice/ranges/six-max.json but not the new src/advice/ranges/hand-order.json (spec §5 requires it, imported by ranges.ts like six-max.json), so the sandbox fails with TS2307 'Cannot find module ./ranges/hand-order.json' and the expected-zero-errors baseline gets 2. 3) tests/advice/range-model.acceptance.test.ts:338-339 'AC#8 a bot style passed into the advice engine fails the typecheck' calls estimateOpponentRanges(view, 'Maniac') at runtime under @ts-expect-error. With the spec §5 rule 1 validation the string is iterated as entries and throws RangeError('Invalid observed stats for seat undefined'). The spec (§3) only considered the type error, not the runtime call.
options: Recommended: extend the D-4 re-pin to three more locked edits: (a) value-bet AC#9 adds 'opponentBasis' to the expected key list; (b) preflop AC#6 adds 'src/advice/ranges/hand-order.json' to the sandbox file list; and for (3), either (c1) re-pin range-model AC#8 to call estimateOpponentRanges(view, 'Maniac' as never) inside expect(...).toThrow(RangeError), or (c2) amend the spec so estimateOpponentRanges ignores a non-array `observed` (no locked edit for AC#8).

Fix only in code without locked edits: (a) is impossible while opponentBasis is on PostflopRecommendation. It would need the basis moved off the recommendation (contradicts AC#3 and D-4). (b) would need the hand order inlined in ranges.ts instead of hand-order.json (contradicts D-1 and §5). (c) is option c2.
